experiment: K16 same-input mean displacement descriptive probes
units: normalized action-draft denoising velocity, NOT physical velocity

definitions.delta: mu_old - mu_new at one identical observation/action draft/time
definitions.new_contrast: (v_F(canonical Left) - v_F(canonical Right))/2, before alpha amplification
definitions.pooling: within a snapshot, equally pool both q and selected denoising records: pooled RMS = sqrt(mean(record RMS squared)); then describe the 20 snapshot values
definitions.ratio: ratio of snapshot-pooled RMS(delta) to snapshot-pooled RMS(new contrast); denominator <=1e-12 yields null and a reported valid-count
definitions.first10: first ten action-horizon positions of the predicted chunk, later executed; not the first ten denoising calls
definitions.initial_denoise0: t=1 query; A/B action drafts and canonical mean moments are identical
definitions.all10_denoise: t=1,...,0.1 along each requested query N draft path; later A/B drafts can differ
definitions.scale_reference: multiplication by checkpoint action.std reverses only the per-coordinate scale for a difference; no action.mean intercept applies to differences

interpretation_limits: 400 queries are repeated measurements on 20 physical snapshots, not 400 independent samples
snapshot min/max are descriptive ranges, not confidence intervals; no significance tests performed
RMS magnitude does not establish functional necessity, semantic storage or causal mediation
action.std-scaled values are velocity-field scale references, NOT completed actions, robot command differences, or end-effector displacement
Euler integration proceeds from t=1 toward t=0 with negative dt; a single draft update is x_next=x+dt*v, so delta-v signs must not be read as physical direction signs
later denoising inputs change with the N reference integration; probes do not give a full hybrid policy trajectory
S groups height, rotation and gripper together; padding is not physically executed but can affect future denoising
